description: Phase 7 molecular descriptors merged with screening-level vertical DFT redox descriptors.

geometry.source: Phase 7 neutral GFN2-xTB optimized rank-1 geometry

CEI-0054.reason: Elevated oxidized-state spin contamination review flag and electron-affinity IQR flag.

limitations: DFT descriptors are electronic energy differences, not Gibbs free energies.
DFT descriptors are not directly electrode-referenced redox potentials.
IEF-PCM represents bulk dielectric polarization but not explicit electrolyte coordination.
Absolute DFT total energies are not used to rank molecules with different molecular formulas.
Four candidates with incomplete charged-state SCF convergence are retained in the original prospective pool but excluded from the DFT-complete feature dataset.
